headline: Ducks’ Troy Terry expected to make season debut Wednesday
take: Daily Faceoff reports Joel Quenneville said Troy Terry will "likely" make his season debut Wednesday against Nashville. The timing is good for Anaheim and a little complicated. The Ducks have won five straight on a scoring binge, 26 goals on chances worth about 17, and are 10.7 goals ahead of their expected goals on the season, the kind of finishing that rarely lasts. Their underlying share is 48% of the chances. A healthy Terry adds a proven playmaker to a lineup missing Ryan Poehling and A.J. Greer, and that matters more for the weeks when Cutter Gauthier's shooting cools than for tonight. Nashville arrives on the second night of a back-to-back, also on a five-game streak.
